sn12.39:1.2: Yañca bhikkhave ceteti yañ ca pakappeti yañ ca anuseti || ārammaṇam etaṃ hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā ||
sn12.39:1.4: tasmiṃ patiṭṭhite viññāṇe virūḷhe nāmarūpassa avakkanti hoti || || 3
sn12.39:1.14: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || || 4
sn12.39:2.1: No ce bhikkhave ceteti no ca pakappeti atha ce anuseti || ārammaṇam etaṃ hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā ||
sn12.39:2.3: Tasmiṃ patiṭṭhite viññāṇe virūḷhe nāmarūpassa avakkanti hoti || || 5
sn12.39:2.5: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || || 6
sn12.39:3.1: Yato ca kho bhikkhave no ceteti no ca pakappeti no ca anuseti || ārammaṇam etaṃ na hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā ||
sn12.39:3.2: ārammaṇe asati patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa na hoti || ||
sn12.39:3.3: Tad appatiṭṭhite viññāṇe avirūḷhe nāmarūpassa avakkanti na hoti || ||
sn12.39:3.5: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotīti || ||
